why_this_file_exists: The unit-to-building link handoff has a writer (a Spark job over silver.building_register_units) and a reader (the building_unit link backfill command), and every name they must agree on lives here once — the third copy of the shape building-unit-handoff.json and building-title-catalog-handoff.json already carry, for the same reason (ADR-0072's prefix incident).
manifest_object_reason: The source is an Iceberg table, so the export decides how many objects it writes; the manifest is written last and names each with its row count, and a loader that cannot find it refuses rather than succeeding at nothing.
partition_rule_reason: 유효한 PNU의 시군구별로 나눈다. 부모 키가 NULL인 행도 연결 철회를 전달한다. PNU 없는 행과 미해결 관계 건수는 manifest에 각각 남긴다.
columns_reason: 호실 PK, 명시적 NULL을 허용하는 부모 건물 PK, building-unit-handoff.json의 관계 근거를 함께 전달한다. 소비자는 현재 활성 승인 원장과 대조한다(ADR-0125).
